classification: source-confirmed failed replacement leaves stale derived route under fallback flag; mutable API conditional
title: A reused travel destination retains its old computed route after routing becomes unavailable
fact: Successful apply_terrain_route writes distance, journey time, itinerary duration and route products then marks computed. A later None terrain or failed outbound/return planning sets only uses_straight_line_estimate=true. Actual map template still passes terrain_route to map producer without consulting that flag, and map producer labels every Some route Computed. Detail prose separately displays straight-line fallback warning.
counterexample: Start with a fresh destination, successfully apply route A, then reapply the same mutable destination for changed start/goal with terrain=None. Route A and its distance/time remain, fallback flag becomes true. Render with this selected destination: overlay remains computed A, details call it a straight-line estimate, and terrain spans/itinerary may retain A. This is a static supported operation sequence; no async planner or browser run claimed.
limits: Ordinary current callers may construct a fresh destination per request; no normal repeated mutation or live failure incident established.
No claim the route cache precision defect or source admission fallback is the same defect; coordinator confirmed no exact accepted alias.
A failed return-plan branch likewise leaves old state, but minimum witness uses terrain=None and needs no source/package/planner malfunction.
suggested_connected_remedy: Represent route derivation and its estimate/computed status as one coordinated product, or reset/rebuild every derived dependency from explicit original fallback data on failure. Preserve genuine routing failure and immutable package ownership.
acceptance_contract: No route replacement failure can label or consume an earlier computed path as the new fallback; overlay, descriptive mode, distance, time, spans and itinerary share one actual captured derivation.
